title: elymus vassiljevii subsp. coeruleus
intro: Elymus vassiljevii subsp. coeruleus, commonly known as the blue wildrye, is a plant species belonging to the grass family (Poaceae). The blue wildrye is valued for its potential health benefits, which may include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, potentially contributing to improved cardiovascular health and reduced oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant may involve its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness. The bioactive constituents of Elymus vassiljevii subsp. coeruleus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that may contribute to its medicinal properties.
